ui.charcrea.nameRules.tooltip:
Your character name must comply with the following rules to be valid:

• It must be between 2 and 20 characters long.
• It must contain only unaccented letters; it may not contain numbers.
• It may contain a maximum of 3 hyphens, which must not be next to each other or at the start or end of the name.
• A maximum of 2 identical characters in a row is allowed.
• A capital letter must be used at the start of the name, and another capital may only be placed after a hyphen. They must be followed by lowercase letters.
• It must contain characters from the Latin alphabet only.
• It must not contain a forbidden word.
